post.summary: Append to the note on a track's day
post.description:
Adds the text on a new line, or stores it if the day has no note. Text whose lines are already in the note, in order and as whole lines, is skipped (unless `allowDuplicate`), so a retry never adds it twice. Empty text changes nothing. On an archived track nothing changes either: requests sent with Prefer: handling=strict get 423 (empty text too), others the stored note. Safe against other writers: it never overwrites a change made meanwhile.
With an `Idempotency-Key` header (a UUID), a retry with the same key and the same parameters is answered as the first request was and changes nothing; see the `idempotencyKey` capability.

allowDuplicate.description: Append the text even if the note already holds it: true or false (also 1/0, on/off, yes/no)

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Text appended, or already there; `text` is the whole stored note, empty if none. On an archived track, without Prefer: handling=strict: nothing written, the stored note. With `Idempotency-Key`: a repeat of an earlier request answers as that request did, and changes nothing

400.description: Date or text invalid, the note would be longer than 500 characters, `allowDuplicate` isn't true or false, or `Idempotency-Key` is not a UUID

409.description: The note kept changing while appending; nothing was written, try again, or a request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still being handled; try again shortly

422.description: This `Idempotency-Key` was used for another request; nothing written

423.description: The track is archived; nothing written. Only for requests sent with Prefer: handling=strict, which otherwise get the 200 above

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.description:
No `OCS-APIRequest`, no `Authorization` and no CSRF token: the token in the address is the credential. GET, POST and HEAD all do what the link is for. Answers JSON unless asked for XML.
A Tick only link ticks a yes/no day, or adds 1 to a counter, or with `value` sets the day to it; `appendNote`, or a POST body sent as `text/plain`, adds a line to the day's note (a line already there is skipped). A View only link answers the day's tick, or a range's, and with `includeNotes` the notes. The day is today in the owner's time zone unless `date` (or `from` and `to`) says otherwise, and must be one of the link's allowed days, never after today.
Tick calls honour `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID) as the API's writes do.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The link's token

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Tick only. Yes/no: true or false (also 1/0, on/off, yes/no). Counter: the day's new value, a whole number from 0 to 2147483647 (0 clears it)

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD); today in the owner's time zone if missing

parameters.name: appendNote
parameters.description: Tick only. Text to add to the day's note on a new line; not with a text body

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: View only. First day of a range (YYYY-MM-DD), with `to`; not with `date`

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: View only. Last day of a range (YYYY-MM-DD), with `from`

parameters.name: includeNotes
parameters.description: View only. Also answer the notes: true or false (also 1/0, on/off, yes/no)

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Tick only: the day's value (1 or 0 for yes/no), and `note`, the whole stored note, when text was appended. View only: the ticks (sparse, newest first), and the notes with `includeNotes`. With `Idempotency-Key`: a repeat of an earlier request answers as that request did, and changes nothing

400.description: A parameter is invalid, the other kind of link's parameters were sent, the track's type can't be ticked by a link yet, or `Idempotency-Key` is not a UUID; nothing done

403.description: A day is outside the link's allowed days; nothing done

404.description: Unknown or revoked link, or its owner can't sign in

409.description: The tick was written, but the note kept changing while appending, or a request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still being handled

422.description: This `Idempotency-Key` was used for another request; nothing written

423.description: The track was archived during the call; only for requests sent with Prefer: handling=strict

get.description: Every track gets an entry, also with no ticks, in track list order.
